title: Uniform sample, k=2, n=24, ℓ=1
description: Each part is an i.i.d. uniform sample on the complex unit sphere, from normalised real Gaussians. The seed for Z is the seed for W plus 1000. Thresholds are μ = 0.05 and K = 2, fixed so that both edge rules can fire on a small sample. These thresholds do not follow the paper's asymptotic hierarchy, and the sample is not an equal-measure partition.
notes: Edge rules are B1 and B2 from Section 3.1.
guarantees is intentionally empty of theorems.
